load_config_relative: load a maskrcnn-benchmark config from a file path relative to the config root directory
load_config_absolute: load a maskrcnn-benchmark config from an absolute file path and return a merged config object
get_config_root_path: get the root path for maskrcnn-benchmark configuration files
test_load_config: test loading a maskrcnn-benchmark config file and verify the merged config values
review_config_loading: review the maskrcnn-benchmark config loading utilities for correctness and best practices
